$comment: ShopifyAPI (#67, #83): `shopify.GraphQL().execute(query, variables, operation_name)` and the REST resources (pyactiveresource classes: `shopify.Product.find()` lists, `find(id)` reads one, `count`, `create(attributes)` sends `{ product: attributes }`, `delete(id)`; `Shop.current()`), on the session activated with `ShopifyResource.activate_session`. The shop and the API version are the session's: the host stays `{shop}.myshopify.com`. Since #92: resources nested under an owner (`Variant.find(product_id=p)` reads `/products/{product_id}/variants.json`, `Transaction.find(order_id=o)`) or whose owner is named (`Metafield.find(resource="products", resource_id=p)`), the owner path picked from the ids given (`paths`); records saved or changed through an instance (`shopify.Product(attributes).save()` POSTs the attributes, or PUTs them when they hold the `id`; `Product.find(id).save()` PUTs, `.destroy()` DELETEs, `Order.find(id).close()` POSTs `/orders/{id}/close.json`). Attributes set one by one (`product.title = t`) are not read. Class names are common words (`Order.find`): only a client the callers pass makes an untyped parameter this SDK's.
